fields.title: Kōkyō Haisui ni yoru Kōzōteki Sonshō ni kansuru Gyōsei Hōkoku

report.subject: Liem Sioe Lan shi no shōgyō tenpo ni oyoboshita kōkyō kōji ryūshutsu no eikyō hyōka
report.author: Controleur J. H. van den Bosch

fields.summary: Shinseisha no zaisan ni okeru kōzōteki hiretsu to tojō shinshoku no chōsa kekka ni kansuru chihō gyōsei hōkoku.
findings: Kōkyō kōji no haisui shisetsu no fuguai ni yori, ryūshutsu sui ga tenpo kiso o chokusetsu shinshoku shita.
Kōzōteki sonshō oyobi shōgyō katsudō no shōgai wa meihaku de ari, kōkyō kōji ni yuru mono de aru.
recommendations: Shinseisha ni tai suru songai baishō matawa kōzō no shūzen kyoka o jisshi suru koto.

claims.fact: Gyōsei hōkoku wa, kōkyō kōji no ryūshutsu ga kōzōteki sonshō o hikiokoshita jijitsu o nintei shite iru.
